changes: Verify approved T12 status, pinned training report/T03 metadata/source hash, row count and ordered ID/label hash before decoding test.
Require the prepared Parquet byte hash to match T12 before publication; an existing file must also match T12.
Write a unique temporary file in the destination directory, close/sync/hash it, then publish with os.link without replacement; clean up only owned temporary files.

cases: source and metadata changes before decoding
coherently changed old metadata rejected against T12
existing file disagrees with frozen hash
partial write followed by OSError or KeyboardInterrupt and successful retry
fsync or link failure and successful retry

real_existing_test_check.mode: restore() with read_parquet and save_prepared_split patched to raise if called

protected_files.scope: source/prepared text data, baseline, RuBERT, Whisper, T11 files/manifest/table/reports and configs

limitations: Only the changed restorer and a guarded existing-file path were exercised; the full project suite was not rerun.
Hard links must be supported by the destination filesystem; failure is reported without an unsafe fallback.
An uncatchable process kill may leave an owned temporary file; the final filename is either absent or fully written.
Repeat review is still pending; no merge or final evaluation performed.
